statement: Proposed all-length O(n (log n)^(1-73/1000000)) exact DFT, from the attributed Swapnil Jain round-six complex network and a written Fourier transfer.
scope: Every positive length; exact complex arithmetic, specified root, and O(log(n+2))-bit integer/address words. Scalar preparation, schedule construction, index work and movement are charged. No finite-precision, numerical-stability or bit-complexity claim.
